newsitem.title: USA: Thorn Apple sees Q3 EPS loss $0.28-$0.31.
newsitem.headline: Thorn Apple sees Q3 EPS loss $0.28-$0.31.

text.p: Thorn Apple Valley Inc said Friday it expects to post a net loss of between $1.7 million and $1.9 million, or $0.28 and $0.31 per share, in the third quarter.
This year's third quarter ended Friday. In the prior year's third quarter, the company posted a net loss of $3.6 million, or $0.63 per share.
Thorn Apple also said it expects to report a net loss for the first three quarters of the fiscal year of between $1.4 million and $1.6 million, or $0.23 and $0.27 per share.
For the same period in the prior year, the company reported a net loss of $10.6 million, or $1.83 per share.

"Although we and others in the slaughtering industry continue to be negatively affected by a lack of market hogs compared with the industry's slaughter capacity, we are benefiting from the improvements in efficiences in our new and renovated plants and we are proud of the significant, continuing improvement over fiscal 1996," president and chief executive Joel Dorfman said in a statement.
